top_signals.title: Emerging Currencies Traded Mixed Amid Oil Plunge, Fed Bets
top_signals.summary: Emerging-market currencies traded mixed on Tuesday as oil plunged on optimism over US-Iran talks and traders adjusted positions ahead of the Federal Reserve rate decision.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
